description: This Java class 'AlarmService' demonstrates scheduling and canceling repeating alarms using AlarmManager, with user interface buttons to start and stop alarms.

classes.name: AlarmService
classes.description: A subclass of Activity that manages scheduling and canceling an alarm which triggers a service execution.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up PendingIntent for the alarm, and configures button click listeners.

methods.name: mStartAlarmListener
methods.description: On click, schedules a repeating alarm to trigger the service after 30 seconds.

methods.name: mStopAlarmListener
methods.description: On click, cancels the scheduled alarm.
